ruleDefinitions.name: Remove Account From Domain Admin Group
ruleDefinitions.description:
Adversaries may interrupt availability of system and network resources by inhibiting access to accounts utilized by legitimate users.
Accounts may be deleted, locked, or manipulated (ex: changed credentials) to remove access to accounts.
 Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Remove\\-ADGroupMember.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-Identity\\ .*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-Members\\ .*"))
